sloka: ते वलाहक संकाशा महाकाया महाबलाः ।अभ्यधावन्त काकुत्स्थम् रथैः वाजिभिः एव च ॥३-२५-९॥
transliteration: te valāhaka saṁkāśā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ ।abhyadhāvanta kākutstham rathaiḥ vājibhiḥ eva ca ॥3-25-9॥

translations.english: Very powerful demons like huge clouds roared, eager to kill Rama in war. They ran forward on chariots, horses and tall elephants, looking like mountain tops.
